skill.name: senior-architect
skill.description: Provides architecture guidance, reference patterns, and helper scripts for reviewing software systems, selecting technology stacks, and producing basic analysis reports.
skill.summary: Plan architecture decisions and system reviews with guided references and simple Python analysis scripts.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms limited filesystem write behavior in the three helper scripts through a user-supplied output path. The markdown code fences, documentation links, anti-pattern headings, and .env setup example are false positives for execution or reconnaissance. No evidence found of prompt injection, network access, credential exfiltration, or destructive behavior.

remediation.issue: Scripts write to a user-provided output path.
remediation.suggestion: Validate --output paths, avoid overwriting existing files by default, and document the write behavior clearly.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes broad shell command examples.
remediation.suggestion: Label commands as examples and require users to review them before running against real projects or clusters.
Warn users to avoid overwriting an existing .env file and to never commit populated secret files.

content.value_statement: Architecture decisions are hard to compare when requirements, trade-offs, and implementation constraints are scattered. This skill gives structured references and helper scripts for system design, technology selection, and basic architecture reporting.
actual_capabilities: Provides reference guidance for architecture patterns, system design workflows, and technology decisions.
Runs Python helper scripts against a target path to produce basic status and findings reports.
Can emit JSON output for script results when the user supplies an output file.
Lists common development, analysis, deployment, and quality check commands.
Covers architecture concerns across frontend, backend, database, cloud, and DevOps stacks.
limitations: The included scripts are scaffolds and do not perform deep dependency or architecture analysis.
The references contain generic examples rather than detailed production patterns.
Commands must be reviewed before running in any real project or deployment environment.
It does not replace expert architecture review or security assessment.

use_cases.title: Review an Existing Project
use_cases.description: Use the references and scripts to frame architecture risks, component boundaries, and next design questions.

use_cases.title: Choose a Technology Stack
use_cases.description: Compare stack options across frontend, backend, database, cloud, and DevOps constraints.

use_cases.title: Prepare Architecture Documentation
use_cases.description: Turn system design notes into decision summaries, trade-off lists, and review-ready documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Map My Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-architect skill to review this project structure. Summarize the main components, risks, and next architecture decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Stack Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these technology options for my product requirements. Include trade-offs, risks, team impact, and a recommended path.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Decision Record
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an architecture decision record for this proposal. Cover context, options, decision, consequences, and follow-up checks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Migration Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a migration review for this system. Identify boundaries, data risks, rollout stages, observability needs, and rollback criteria.

output_examples.input: A team asks for a quick architecture review before adding GraphQL to a Next.js and PostgreSQL product.
output: A component summary that separates client, API, data, and deployment concerns.
A trade-off review for GraphQL adoption, including caching, schema ownership, and team readiness.
A short decision list covering what to prototype before implementation.

output_examples.input: A lead needs to compare Flutter, React Native, and native mobile options for a new application.
output: A comparison matrix covering team skills, platform access, release workflow, and long-term maintenance.
A recommendation tied to product scope, performance needs, and hiring constraints.

output_examples.input: A platform owner wants a migration plan from a monolith to clearer service boundaries.
output: A migration outline with candidate boundaries, shared data concerns, rollout phases, and rollback checks.
A risk list focused on ownership, observability, deployment coupling, and operational load.

best_practices: Review generated recommendations against project goals before acting.
Run scripts on a copy or branch when testing output behavior.
Pair architecture suggestions with measurable constraints such as latency, team size, and release cadence.
anti_patterns: Treating scaffold script output as a complete architecture audit.
Running deployment commands from examples without environment-specific review.
Selecting technologies before documenting requirements and trade-offs.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps structure architecture reviews, technology decisions, system design notes, and basic project analysis.

faq.question: Does it generate full production diagrams?
faq.answer: No. The diagram script is a scaffold and produces basic report output only.

faq.question: Can it analyze dependencies automatically?
faq.answer: It includes a dependency analyzer scaffold, but deeper dependency logic must be added by the user.

faq.question: Is it safe to run on private repositories?
faq.answer: Review the scripts first. They inspect a local target path and can write output when requested.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it replace an architect?
faq.answer: No. It provides structure and starter material for expert review.
